title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check strips Valuation!H60:L64 data-table formulas before recalculation and fails valid MCP/openpyxl submissions (Unit 3 false negative)
evidence: This verifier carries weight 1 (100% of total score) and scored Unit 3 as 0.0: 'FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.7525. 25 cell error(s): Modification error at Valuation!H60: answer=146.672249802561, output=119.506925677425; ...'. In Unit 3 (steps [30]–[35]), the agent copied 09_02_PepsiCo_input.xlsx to /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx and called excel_set_formula_range 5 times to write all 5 required formula ranges (Financials!F6:O6, Financials!E131:O131, Assumptions!E26:O26, Ratio_Analysis !F25:O25, and Valuation!K36:O36). Out of 101 total modification cells across the workbook, all 76 regular formula and downstream DCF cells (including Valuation!K36:O36 and the data-table anchor Valuation!G59 = 99.0365089055261) matched the ground truth (76/101 = 0.7525). The only 25 failing cells are the pre-existing two-variable sensitivity table in Valuation!H60:L64 (<f aca="true">TABLE($G$59,$E$67,$G60,$E$23,H$59)</f>), which retained the untouched input workbook's cached values (119.506925677425, 90.5921275564814, etc.). This happened because: (1) the MCP Excel backend (uno_backend.py:2143, 2315, 2471) snapshots Valuation!H60:L64's pre-save cached values via snapshot_datatable_values and overwrites LibreOffice's updated table values via restore_datatable_values on every save; and (2) verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells (spreadsheetbench2.py:293) calls managed_recalculated_xlsx(..., force_recalculation=True) -> recalculate_xlsx (libreoffice.py:1184), which calls freeze_datatable_formulas(patched_input) to strip all TABLE(...) formulas before LibreOffice recalculates the file, without calling data_tables.with_computed_tables. As a result, any correct solution produced via the MCP Excel tools or openpyxl (as recommended in problem.py:13-22) fails all 25 cells in Valuation!H60:L64 and scores 0.0, whereas Units 1 and 2 only passed because they wrote custom scripts invoking soffice directly.
confirmation: Valuation!H60:L64 are =TABLE($G$59,...) data-table cells whose input cache (H60=119.51) differs from GT (146.67) once the required FCFF formulas feed G59.
